name: west-north-houses
coordinate_system: Inherited world coordinates, Y up; root-pixel ground anchors projected using ctx.pixelToWorld.
notes: Three detached, fully enclosed houses with solid roof slopes and gables, stone foundations, framed openings and entrance steps.
The straw cottage includes its attached slate-covered entry; the slate cottage is completed beneath the graphic pin.
No changes to shared roads; no market objects, trees, terrain or graphics included.
Synchronous browser build; procedural thatch texture requires document.createElement('canvas').
Reference and four-compass render evidence is in evidence/; visual limitations and integration details are documented in account.md.
